questions.question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

I don’t remember exactly when the clouds rolled in and ____ you from me.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Stole**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, indicating that the action of the clouds rolling in and separating the speaker from the person they are addressing has already happened.
 
• The verb "**stole**" is in past tense and fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The word "stole" suggests that the clouds took away the person from the speaker, emphasizing a sense of loss or separation.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence**: *I don’t remember exactly when the clouds rolled in and stole __you from me.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Steal **is the present tense form of the verb.
 
• **Stealing **is the present participle (v+ing) form of the verb.
 
• **Stolen **is the past participle (v3) form of the verb but does not fit the sentence structure as it requires an auxiliary verb (e.g. "**had stolen**").

questions.question: Change the following active voice sentence into passive voice: "The restaurant will offer a significant discount on vegetarian dishes throughout the summer season."

options.text: A significant discount on vegetarian dishes will be offered by the restaurant throughout the summer season
Throughout the summer season, the restaurant will be offered a significant discount on vegetarian dishes.
A significant discount will offer the restaurant on vegetarian dishes throughout the summer season.
Throughout the summer season, a significant discount on vegetarian dishes is to be offered by the restaurant.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1' i.e. **'A significant discount on vegetarian dishes will be offered by the restaurant throughout the summer season.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure is generally as Object + Auxiliary Verb + Past Participle + by + Subject.
 
• The given sentence in the question is in active voice. We changed it to passive voice as asked.
 
• The passive voice focuses more on the action done rather on the doer. In this case, 'a significant discount' which is the object in the original sentence becomes the focus in the passive voice.
 
• The sentence 'A significant discount on vegetarian dishes' (object) 'will be offered' (auxiliary verb and past participle) 'by the restaurant' (subject) is in passive voice.

**Therefore, the correct answer is "A significant discount on vegetarian dishes will be offered by the restaurant throughout the summer season."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 incorrectly suggests that the restaurant would be receiving the discount, not offering it.
 
• Option 3 swaps the object and the subject, and thus, changes the entire meaning of the sentence.
 
• Option 4 alters the tense to future with 'is to be' form which is inaccurate.

questions.question:
Direction: A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active voice.

Where was the sculpture being painted by you?

options.text: Where were you been painting the sculpture?
Where were you paint the sculpture?
Where were you being painting the sculpture?
Where were you painting the sculpture?

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **Where were you painting the sculpture?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Passive voice form, hence we need to convert it into Active voice form.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject is 'sculpture' and the object is 'you' so for making the active form of this sentence, we need to exchange their places of object and subject.
 
• We need to follow these instructions while changing the passive voice into the active voice.
 
 
• If the **Wh+ word** is present in the **active voice**, then we start the **passive voice** with the same **Wh+ word**.
 
• **For Example:-**
 
 
• Active Voice - Where were you painting the wall?
 
• Passive Voice - Where was the wall being painted by you?
 
 
 
• The sentence is in **past continuous tense**, therefore, it will follow the given structure:-
 
 
• Active Voice - **was/were + Vᵢₙg**
 
• Passive Voice - **was/were + being + V₃**
 
 
 
• The **overall structure** of the two voices will be:-
 
 
• Active Voice - **Wh word + helping verb + subject + Vᵢₙg + Object.**
 
• Passive Voice - **Wh word + helping verb + object + being + V₃ + by + subject.**
 
 
 
 

**Therefore, the correct passive voice is** *Where were you painting the sculpture?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When we convert active voice to passive voice, three things need to be kept in mind:-

 
 
• Change object into subject.
 
• Change subject into object.
 
• Always use the third form of the verb in the passive voice.
 
 
 
• Use 'by' before the new object.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

I asked my niece if she wanted that doll.

options.text: I said to my niece, "Do you want this doll?"
I asked to my niece, "Did you want this doll?"
I asked my niece, "If you wanted this doll?"
I said to my niece, "Do you wanted that doll?"

questions.solution:
The direct form of the given sentence is **'I said to my niece, "Do you want this doll?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• While changing an interrogative sentence from indirect speech to direct speech, we need to follow these steps-

 
 
• The conjunction '**if**' is replaced with a comma (,) and inverted commas (" ").
 
• 'Asked' remains either unchanged or changed into 'said to'.
 
• The full stop (.) is changed into the question mark (?).
 
• The past indefinite tense (v2- wanted) is changed into the present indefinite tense (Do + v1- do + want).
 
• The third-person (she) is changed into (you) i.e. according to the object of the reporting verb (my niece).
 
• '**That**' is changed into '**this**'.

 
 
 

**The final sentence-** *I said to my niece, "Do you want this doll?"*

questions.question:
Given below are six sentences, out of which sentences A and F are in the correct position. Sentences B, C, D and E are in a jumbled order. Select the option that gives the correct order.

A. In Jhum cultivation, a patch of land is cleared, and vegetation is burned.

B. The same practice is repeated elsewhere on a fresh piece of land.

C. Then this area is abandoned and is left to recover its fertility. 

D. This patch of land is used for raising crops for two to three years, and the yield is modest.

E. Then the ash is mixed with the soil thus adding nutrients to the soil.

F. All that is required for this method of cultivation is a set of simple tools, not a high level of mechanization.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. "AEDCBF."
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• **Sentence A** is the first sentence as per the given instructions. It begins with the preposition 'In' and talks about Jhum cultivation and describes its process.
 
• **Sentence E** is the second sentence as it begins with the adverb 'then' and mentions the next step that is followed.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 2.
 
• **Sentence D** is the third sentence. It begins with the pronoun 'This' and mentions how much time the land can be used for cultivation and the quantity of harvest.
 
• **Sentence C** is the fourth sentence as it expresses what is done after two to three years of raising crops with moderate yield.
 
• **Sentence B** is the fifth sentence as it mentions the farmers then find new land and continue the same process.
 
• **Sentence F** is the last sentence as per the given instructions. It mentions that Jhum cultivation does not require high mechanical tools but only simple tools.
 
• The correct arrangement is AEDCBF.

 

The correct order is:__ 

 
• A. In Jhum cultivation, a patch of land is cleared, and vegetation is burned.
 
• E. Then the ash is mixed with the soil thus adding nutrients to the soil.
 
• D. This patch of land is used for raising crops for two to three years, and the yield is modest.
 
• C. Then this area is abandoned and is left to recover its fertility. 
 
• B. The same practice is repeated elsewhere on a fresh piece of land.
 
• F. All that is required for this method of cultivation is a set of simple tools, not a high level of mechanization.

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

A trip to the village temple was made by Bhavani yesterday.

options.text: Bhavani was going to make a trip to the temple yesterday.
Bhavani made a trip to the village temple yesterday.
Bhavani tripped to the village temple yesterday.
Bhavani is going to make a trip to the temple today.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'****Bhavani made a trip to the village temple yesterday.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **passive voice.** As per the question we have to change it into** active voice.**
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• **Subject (objective case) + was + past participle + by Object (subjective case) (Passive voice) + adjunct**
 
• **Subject + past participle + Object (Active voice) + adjunct**
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *A large house was built by her. (Passive voice)*
 
• *She built a large house. (Active voice)*
 
 
 
• The **subject **of the given sentence is ‘Bhavani’.
 
• The object of the given subject is ‘trip’.
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• **was made **will be changed to **made**.
 
• **Adjunct **is a word or phrase that constitutes an optional element or is considered of secondary importance in a sentence
 
 
• In the given sentence, *to the village temple yesterday *is the **adjunct. **
 
 
 
• **Thus, **the correct answer is** option 2.**

**Correct sentence__ - ***Bhavani made a trip to the village temple yesterday.*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

You told me that you had not slept the previous night and could not work then.

options.text: You said to me, "I have not slept last night and could not work then."
You said to me, "I did not sleep last night and cannot work now."
You said to me, "You did not sleep the previous night and could not work now."
You said to me, "I have not slept the previous night and cannot work then."

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. You said to me, "I did not sleep last night and cannot work now."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the given directions, we have to change it into Direct Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be removed and comma and inverted commas will be added.
 
• In the direct speech 'told' will be changed into 'said to' because reporting verb has an object,** 'me.'**
 
• Now, let's focus on the reported speech.
 
• 'you' will be changed into 'I.'
 
• Here, ‘had not slept’ is in the past perfect tense and will be changed into simple past i.e., **'**did not sleep.'
 
• Also, **'**the previous night' will be changed into 'last night.'
 
• 'could not work' will be changed into 'cannot work.'
 
• **'then'** will be changed into **'now.'**

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While changing the narration of an interrogative sentence in the present continuous tense into the affirmative sentence in the reported form we make the following changes
 
• The quotation marks get omitted and the question mark gets replaced by a full stop.
 
• When the question in the direct speech begins with "**WH" **question then conjunction "that" is not used as the "question word" itself acts as a joining clause.
 
• The present continuous tense of the question in the direct speech changes to the past continuous tense in the indirect speech.
 
• The correct sentence is* 'Ram asked me when I was coming to meet him.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__*​***

__
 
• If the reporting verb is given in Past tense then the tense of the verb of Reported Speech will change into the corresponding Past tense.

 
 
• Example: * *Direct: *The teacher said, “I am suffering from a fever.”*

 * *Indirect: *The teacher said that she was suffering from a fever.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• Present continuous tense में एक interrogative वाक्य के narration को रिपोर्ट किए गए रूप में affirmative वाक्य में बदलते समय हम निम्नलिखित परिवर्तन करते हैं।
 
• Quotation marks हटा दिए जाते हैं और question mark को full stop से बदल दिया जाता है।
 
• जब direct speech में प्रश्न "WH" प्रश्न से शुरू होता है तो conjunction "that" का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है तथा "प्रश्न शब्द" स्वयं में joining clause के रूप में कार्य करता है।
 
• Direct speech में प्रश्न का present continuous tense, indirect speech में past continuous tense में बदल जाता है।
 
• सही वाक्य है *'*Ram asked me when I was coming to meet him.​'
